name: Sabrina Repp - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on the implementation of the EU Youth Strategy 2019-2027
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its views on how the EU's youth strategy for 2019-2027 has worked and what should come after 2027. It asks the European Commission and member states to keep a core youth strategy, check the impact of new policies on young people, involve young people properly in decisions, and do more on housing, mental health, jobs, education and help for rural and disadvantaged youth. The report is an opinion; it does not change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. Parliament asks the Commission and member states to act on youth policy, housing, mental health and jobs.
- **Who it affects:** Young people aged roughly 15 to 29, youth organisations, and national and local authorities.
- **What happens next:** The resolution goes to the Council, the Commission and youth organisations; the Commission decides whether to act.
